clue.text: Extremist spoke about Conservative

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: a radial is a spoke, a line running out from a centre

explanation.surface: A hardline speaker addressed the subject of a Tory politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A radical is someone holding extreme political views, an extremist.

clue.text: Bird, duck, in list

indicators.note: in places the duck inside the list

parts.note: a roster is a list of names on duty
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A bird, a duck, appears on a list.
explanation.definitionFit: A rooster is a male domestic fowl, a kind of bird.

clue.text: Unforthcoming, drunk conveyed a false impression keeping very quiet

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: lied means told an untruth, conveying a false impression
pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet

explanation.surface: A reticent drunk who misled people while staying silent.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tight-lipped says little, so is unforthcoming and reticent.

clue.text: Sticky substance on back

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word backwards

parts.note: in cricket the on side is also called the leg side

explanation.surface: Something sticky is applied to someone's back.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side and the leg side are the same half of the field, so on gives LEG.
explanation.definitionFit: Gel is a jelly-like viscous material, a sticky substance such as hair gel.

clue.text: Shake toy

definitions.meaning: a baby's toy that makes a noise when shaken

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to unsettle someone and a noisy plaything for an infant.

clue.text: Leaves lines by English author

parts.note: Henry Green was an English novelist
RY, railway, gives lines

explanation.surface: An English writer's lines are left on the page.
explanation.walkthrough: Graham Greene tempts, but the E comes from English; the author is Henry Green, and the charade runs in answer order despite 'by'.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenery is green foliage, a mass of leaves.

clue.text: Peddler in newspaper article — Bond, somehow, recalled name

parts.note: rag is a disparaging term for a newspaper
an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters of the name are arranged in some new way
recalled read as called back, so the word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about Bond somehow brought a name back to mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' scrambles BOND into DBON, and 'recalled' turns NAME into EMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A rag-and-bone man is a street trader collecting and selling old goods, a kind of peddler; a familiar British figure with a horse and cart.

clue.text: Full of sorrow, the banker rode off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters have gone wrong or awry, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: The bank official rode away grieving.
explanation.definitionFit: Being heartbroken means being overwhelmed with grief.

clue.text: Type of cooking to beat entry number one?

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
a door is a way of entry
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A question of how to surpass the top restaurant entry in a cookery contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Tandoori is a style of Indian cooking in a clay oven.

clue.text: Appropriate to understand, having married fifty years later

parts.note: to see is to understand
L is the Roman numeral fifty

explanation.surface: It's fitting to grasp what marriage means only after fifty years.
explanation.definitionFit: Seemly behaviour is proper and fitting, appropriate to the occasion.

clue.text: Record includes adultery, principally — he's no gent

indicators.note: includes means the record holds the other letter within it

parts.note: CD, a compact disc, is a record

indicators.note: principally points to the main or first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A man's record shows adultery, so he's no gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A cad is a man who behaves dishonourably, the opposite of a gentleman.

clue.text: Request medicinal substance for the skin?

definitions.meaning: a formal request, as for a job
something applied to the skin, such as an ointment

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a formal request and a lotion that is put on the body.

clue.text: Speak nonstop

definitions.meaning: to put into words, to voice

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to put into words and a fast service with no intermediate stops.

clue.text: Father figure produces the goods

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, as a priest's title
eight is a number, a figure

explanation.surface: A father figure delivers what is expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Freight is cargo, the goods carried by a vehicle.

clue.text: Sappers become weary so withdraw

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are the army's sappers
to tire is to become weary

explanation.surface: Army engineers get tired and pull out.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire is to retreat or withdraw.

clue.text: Bright night light sailor follows initially

indicators.note: initially says this piece comes at the start, before the sailor

parts.note: dogs means follows closely
tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor at first follows a bright light in the night sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' is the charade signal: the clue's 'follows' word goes to the front even though the sailor is named first.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dog Star, Sirius, is the brightest star in the night sky.

clue.text: Prompt choking at a note in book

indicators.note: choking means gripping round the throat, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: a cue is a prompt
taken as written
to log is to note down

explanation.surface: A prompt sticks in the throat over a note in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'choking' wraps the prompt around the rest; 'book' as the definition is a noun, a listing of items, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A catalogue is a book listing items, such as goods for sale.

clue.text: Landowner's day off in retreat

indicators.note: off means removed, so that letter goes

parts.note: a laird is a Scottish landowner

explanation.surface: A landowner takes a day off in a retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: A lair is a den or hideaway, a retreat.

clue.text: Comic strip character in game, forward needing support

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game
pert means cheeky, forward
to bear is to support

explanation.surface: A cartoon figure plays a game, a forward needing support.
explanation.walkthrough: Rupert Bear is a long-running British children's comic strip character.
explanation.definitionFit: Rupert Bear is a famous British cartoon character, a comic strip star.

clue.text: Veteran, serving man at heart

indicators.note: at heart says only the central part, without the outer letters, is kept

parts.note: a soldier is a man serving in the army

explanation.surface: An army veteran is a soldier at heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at heart' strips the first and last letters, S and R, from SOLDIER.
explanation.definitionFit: An oldie is an old person, so a veteran.

clue.text: Pair of wrestlers, game couple

parts.note: tag is a children's chasing game
to team is to couple or yoke together

explanation.surface: A pair of wrestlers, a game couple.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag team is a duo of wrestlers who take turns in the ring.

clue.text: Call about supporter bringing one to this motor sport

indicators.note: about means going round, so the call surrounds the supporter

parts.note: to ring is to call by telephone
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: A rallying call brings a supporter along to motor racing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bringing one to this' is surface colour linking to the definition: a rallying call brings people together.
explanation.definitionFit: Rallying is the sport of driving cars over public roads or rough terrain in timed stages.

clue.text: In a defenceless position, like one cornered by boxer?

definitions.meaning: a fighter pinned against the ring's edge by the opponent

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means near collapse, and literally describes a fighter driven back against the ring.

clue.text: Scratch head in Tate Modern after touring cathedral

indicators.note: after touring suggests the letters have been sent around and are mixed up
scratch means delete, and head is the first letter, so that letter is removed

explanation.surface: Puzzled visitor scratches their head at an art gallery after a cathedral trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scratch head' deletes the first letter of the gallery's first word, leaving ATE; 'after touring' is the anagram signal, mixing that with the second word.
explanation.definitionFit: Notre-Dame is the famous Gothic cathedral in Paris.

clue.text: Old Boy's story about cold bar

parts.note: OB is Old Boy, a former pupil; with the possessive S

indicators.note: about means going round, so the story surrounds the letter

parts.note: a tale is a story

explanation.surface: A former pupil tells a story about a cold bar.
explanation.definitionFit: An obstacle is a barrier, a bar to progress.

clue.text: Had finished, it's admitted

parts.note: to have something is to own it
up can mean over, finished, as in time is up

explanation.surface: Someone had finished, it is now confessed.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is to confess, so owned up means admitted.

clue.text: Getting rid of matzo ball left out?

indicators.note: out means the letter is taken away

parts.note: a matzo ball is a kind of dumpling in Jewish cookery

explanation.surface: A question of whether a cook is discarding a matzo ball left uneaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumping is discarding, getting rid of something.

clue.text: Type of ring, reportedly for aquatic bird

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a signet is a ring bearing a seal

explanation.surface: A kind of ring is said to be meant for a water bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A cygnet is a young swan, a water bird.

clue.text: Highly decorated knight taken away to make a speech

indicators.note: taken away means the letter is removed

parts.note: ornate means elaborately decorated; that the letters also sit inside the word decorated is a coincidence
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: A much-decorated knight is led off to make a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to deliver a formal address.

clue.text: Hard to lose opening argument

indicators.note: to lose opening means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: stiff means hard, rigid

explanation.surface: It's hard to lose the opening argument in a debate.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty quarrel, a minor argument.
